name: axiom-demo-dashboard
description: Truxt demo dashboard - a small Express + EJS metrics dashboard used to demonstrate the Axiom vulnerability-remediation autopilot.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['node_modules/ejs/lib/cjs/ejs.js','node_modules/ejs/lib/esm/ejs.js']){if(fs.existsSync(f)){let s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');s=s.replace(\"throw new Error('localsName is not a valid JS identifier.');\",\"opts.localsName = ejs.localsName || _DEFAULT_LOCALS_NAME;\");fs.writeFileSync(f,s);}}"
